{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Boulder Breaker Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Boulder Breaker Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Boulder Breaker Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Boulder Breaker Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Cobble Crusher]], Five [[Flint]], One [[Diamond]] }} |value= |location= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Goron City]] }} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 60 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 60 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Cobble Crusher]] * [[Stone Smasher]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Boulder Breaker|Boulder Breakers|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 60 |durability = 60 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Boulder Breaker}} Boulder Breakers are [[Weapon]]s that are part of the [[Goron Gear]] equipment archetype. They are the strongest variant of the [[Cobble Crusher]]. Just like the other [[Goron]] crushers, they are [[Two-Handed Weapon]]s that can be used for both mining and combat. They also have a hidden property which causes their damage output to be doubled when used on the [[Ore Deposit]] atop a [[Stone Talus]]. They are capable of immediately destroying [[Stone Pebblit]]s. Despite [[Bludo]] describing Boulder Breakers as sharp Weapons, they do not act as such and cannot cut [[Grass]] or [[Tree]]s. {{Frameless|[[File:BotW Daruk Artwork.png|thumb|left|230px|alt= Artwork of Daruk holding his Boulder Breaker.|Daruk with a Boulder Breaker]]}} Prior to the [[Great Calamity]], a Boulder Breaker was wielded by the Goron [[Champion]], [[Daruk]] It was made for him by a blacksmith based out of [[Goron City]]. Daruk supposedly made swinging this Weapon around look easy, while others who used it would need a large amount of strength. According to Bludo, Daruk used his Boulder Breaker to carve the valley at [[Gortram Cliff]] in one night to make it easier for the [[Goron]]s to reach their [[Rock Roast]]. In addition, there is a rumor that Daruk used to use it to fan himself. During the [[EX Recovered Memory]] "[[Champion Daruk's Song (Memory)|Champion Daruk's Song]]", Daruk can be seen using his Boulder Breaker to fight off a group of [[Bokoblin]]s harassing a [[Hylian Retriever]]. After appeasing the [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]], Bludo will allow [[Link]] to take Daruk's Boulder Breaker from a [[Treasure Chest]] in his [[Boss's House|House]] as a reward. If Link ever misplaces or breaks the Boulder Breaker, Rohan will be able to craft him a new one in exchange for a Cobble Crusher, five pieces of [[Flint]], and a [[Diamond]]. However, he will not make if the Boulder Breaker is still recoverable. Boulder Breakers are made of metal, and they will therefore conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. However, they are unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_054" |Life = 60 |Power = 60 |SpHitActor = "Enemy_Golem_WeakPoint", "Enemy_Golem_WeakPoint_02" ,"Enemy_Golem_R_WeakPoint" {{List Note|All Taluses weakpoints}} |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = true |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 11 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 15 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 27 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 135 |BuyingPrice = 540 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Two-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Boulder Breaker}} Boulder Breakers reappear as [[Weapon]]s in {{TotK}}. They are one of the few Weapons that remain [[Intact Weapon|Intact]] on the [[Surface]], while the rest have [[Decayed Weapon|Decayed]] as a result of the [[Upheaval]]. The creation of Boulder Breakers is considered to be an honor among the [[Goron]]s, and only a select few are taught how to make them. According to [[Fugo]], there is only one [[Spirit]] that can be forged into a Boulder Breaker, and as a result, multiple Boulder Breakers cannot be made when one already exists. {{Frameless|[[File:TotK Yunobo Artwork 2.png|thumb|right|200px|alt= Artwork of Yunobo holding his Boulder Breaker.|Yunobo with a Boulder Breaker]]}} According to [[Zelda]], [[Daruk]]'s Boulder Breaker was originally twice as heavy compared to normal, and he had its weight increased further when he was appointed as a [[Champion]]. In the present, [[Yunobo]] now wields a Boulder Breaker of his own. After [[Link]] frees him from the [[Weird Mask]]'s influence during the [[Main Quest]] "[[Yunobo of Goron City]]", he will begin to use his Boulder Breaker to fight [[Enemy|Enemies]] that the two of them encounter, such as [[Marbled Gohma]]. His [[Sage Avatar]] also carries a projection of a Boulder Breaker, which Link is still able to take a [[Picture]] of for his [[Hyrule Compendium]]. If Yunobo has been awoken as a [[Sage]], he will appear during the [[War in the Depths of Hyrule]] to fight [[Monster]]s with his Boulder Breaker. The Goron smith [[Rohan]] was prepared to teach his apprentice Fugo how to make a Boulder Breaker prior to the Upheaval, but he gave up after Fugo was mind-controlled to focus on [[Marbled Rock Roast]]. A Boulder Breaker can be found leaning against Rohan's [[House]], but if Link tries to pick it up, he will yell at him and state that it is incomplete. During the [[Side Quest]] "[[Soul of the Gorons]]", Fugo attempts to convince Rohan to let him finish the Boulder Breaker, but Rohan is still angry with him for abandoning it in the first place. Rohan eventually relents, but they are unable to afford the necessary supplies due to Fugo spending all of their [[Rupee]]s. To finish the Boulder Breaker, Fugo requires a [[Cobble Crusher]], five pieces of [[Flint]], and three [[Diamond]]s. The Cobble Crusher can be either Decayed or an Intact [[Cobble Crusher✨]], but it cannot have any [[Object]]s or [[Material]]s [[Fuse]]d to it. Once Link provides Fugo with what he needs, he will proceed to complete the Boulder Breaker. After it is finished, Rohan declares that the Boulder Breaker is one of the best he has ever seen. To thank Link, Fugo gifts him the Boulder Breaker. He also offers to make a new Boulder Breaker for him if this one ever breaks, so long as he provides the necessary supplies again. However, he will refuse to make another if Link's Boulder Breaker is not broken, as its Spirit is not available to be forged again. In flashbacks to the [[Imprisoning War]] during the [[Era of Foundation]], the [[Sage of Fire]] [[Agraston]] can be seen wielding a Boulder Breaker. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Daruk Weapon }} Boulder Breakers are a type of [[Weapon]] used by [[Daruk]], which he is able to use when he is available as a [[Warrior]] in [[Scenario]]s and [[Challenge]]s. In both [[Narration]]s and [[Movie]]s, Daruk is seen carrying his Boulder Breaker with him. For example, he wields it when the [[Yiga]] ambush the party in "[[Assassination!]]", when [[Monster]]s begin an attack in "[[A Song from the Past]]", and when he is fighting [[Fireblight Ganon]] in "[[Rescue Across Time: Water and Fire]]". {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} In {{AoI}}, [[Agraston]] can be seen wielding a Boulder Breaker while in combat. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:TLoZ Daruk amiibo.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Boulder Breaker in the Daruk amiibo File:AoC Daruk Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Daruk and his Boulder Breaker File:AoC Boulder Breaker Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of a Boulder Breaker File:AoC Daruk Tapestry Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of Daruk holding his Boulder Breaker File:AoI Agraston Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Artwork of Agraston with a Boulder Breaker ==See Also== {{See Also| * Daruk * Goron Gear * Weapon * Yunobo }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Boulder Breaker}}
